answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by making every identity post a slashable bond funded through a single visible beacon of trust: a public registry where peers attest to real work. Like water carving karst, cheap fake accounts slowly dissolve under scrutiny, while honest agents stack reputation flat and solid as a mesa. If an identity is exposed as a sockpuppet, its bond burns and its attestors lose stake too, so spawning a thousand selves means risking a thousand bonds for one reward.
